```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo cycle` — the run the scheduled task performs every 15 minutes (P4).
// Per repo: capture --sweep → process → render reports → commit .memory/.
// One repo failing never stops the others; the command always exits 0.

const path = require('node:path');

const { memoHome } = require('./paths');
const config = require('./config');
const repos = require('./repos');
const { acquire } = require('./lock');
const { log } = require('./log');
const { writeJsonAtomic, readJson, isoLocal } = require('./util');
const capture = require('./capture/capture');
const extract = require('./extract/process');
const brief = require('./brief');
const memoryCommit = require('./gitops/memory-commit');

const LOCK_STALE_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000;
// Worst → best. The repo keeps the worst thing that happened to it.
const SEVERITY = ['error', 'api_failed', 'no_identity', 'git_busy', 'budget_reached', 'capture_gap', 'ok', 'no_new_data'];
// Capture results that mean "data may be missing", not "nothing happened".
const GAP_STATUSES = ['error', 'busy', 'bad_cursors', 'transcript_missing', 'no_transcript', 'transcript_rewritten'];
const OK_CYCLE = ['ok', 'no_new_data', 'paused'];

function lockPath() {
  return path.join(memoHome(), 'cycle.lock');
}

function statusPath() {
  return path.join(memoHome(), 'status.json');
}

function worst(a, b) {
  return SEVERITY.indexOf(a) <= SEVERITY.indexOf(b) ? a : b;
}

/**
 * One repo: capture, process, report, commit.
 * @returns {object} the line logged to cycles.jsonl
 */
async function runRepo(repo, cfg, { callsLeft = null, providerImpl = null } = {}) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const line = {
    event: 'repo', repo: path.basename(repo.root), repoId: repo.id,
    newEvents: 0, jobs: 0, calls: 0, in: 0, out: 0, costEst: 0,
    committed: null, status: 'no_new_data', ms: 0
  };

  const captured = capture.sweepRepo(repo);
  for (const c of captured) line.newEvents += Number(c.newEvents) || 0;
  if (captured.some((c) => GAP_STATUSES.includes(c.status))) line.status = worst(line.status, 'capture_gap');

  let processed = null;
  if (cfg.apiEnabled === false) {
    line.apiSkipped = 'api_disabled';
  } else {
    processed = await extract.processRepo({ repo, cfg, maxCalls: callsLeft, providerImpl });
    line.jobs = processed.jobs;
    line.calls = processed.calls;
    line.in = processed.in;
    line.out = processed.out;
    line.costEst = processed.costEst;
    if (processed.leftover > 0) line.leftover = processed.leftover;
    if (['api_failed', 'budget_reached', 'error'].includes(processed.status)) {
      line.status = worst(line.status, processed.status);
    } else if (processed.jobs > 0) {
      line.status = worst(line.status, 'ok');
    }
  }

  // Reports are cheap and deterministic; re-render whenever anything landed.
  if (line.newEvents > 0 || line.jobs > 0) {
    try {
      brief.report(repo.root);
      line.status = worst(line.status, 'ok');
    } catch (err) {
      line.status = worst(line.status, 'error');
      line.error = 'report: ' + (err && err.message);
    }
  }

  const commit = memoryCommit.commitMemory(repo.root, { cfg });
  if (commit.status === 'committed') {
    line.committed = commit.hash;
    line.status = worst(line.status, 'ok');
  } else if (commit.status === 'git_busy' || commit.status === 'no_identity') {
    line.status = worst(line.status, commit.status);
  }

  line.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return line;
}

/**
 * The whole cycle. Never throws.
 * @returns {{status: string, repos: object[], ms: number, skipped?: string}}
 */
async function runCycle({ cfg = config.ensure(), providerImpl = null } = {}) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const lock = acquire(lockPath(), { staleMs: LOCK_STALE_MS });
  if (!lock) {
    log('cycles', { event: 'overlap_skip', status: 'skipped' });
    return { status: 'skipped', reason: 'overlap_skip', repos: [], ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  }
  if (lock.recovered) log('cycles', { event: 'stale_lock_recovered', status: 'ok' });

  try {
    log('cycles', { event: 'cycle_start', status: 'running', pid: process.pid });

    if (cfg.paused === true) {
      log('cycles', { event: 'cycle_end', status: 'paused', repos: 0, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
      writeStatus({ status: 'paused', repos: [], ms: Date.now() - t0, cfg });
      return { status: 'paused', repos: [], ms: Date.now() - t0 };
    }

    const list = repos.load().filter((r) => r && r.enabled !== false);
    const lines = [];
    let callsLeft = Number(cfg.maxCallsPerCycle);
    for (const repo of list) {
      let line;
      try {
        line = await runRepo(repo, cfg, { callsLeft, providerImpl });
      } catch (err) {
        line = {
          event: 'repo', repo: path.basename(repo.root), repoId: repo.id,
          newEvents: 0, jobs: 0, calls: 0, in: 0, out: 0, costEst: 0,
          committed: null, status: 'error', error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err), ms: 0
        };
      }
      callsLeft = Math.max(0, callsLeft - (Number(line.calls) || 0));
      log('cycles', line);
      lines.push(line);
    }

    const status = lines.every((l) => OK_CYCLE.includes(l.status)) ? 'ok' : 'failed';
    const ms = Date.now() - t0;
    log('cycles', { event: 'cycle_end', status, repos: lines.length, ms });
    writeStatus({ status, repos: lines, ms, cfg });
    return { status, repos: lines, ms };
  } catch (err) {
    const ms = Date.now() - t0;
    log('cycles', { event: 'cycle_end', status: 'failed', error: err && err.message, ms });
    writeStatus({ status: 'failed', repos: [], ms, cfg, error: err && err.message });
    return { status: 'failed', repos: [], ms, error: err && err.message };
  } finally {
    lock.release();
  }
}

// ~/.memo/status.json — what `memo status` reads without parsing the logs.
function writeStatus({ status, repos: lines, ms, cfg, error = null }) {
  const now = isoLocal();
  let prev = {};
  try { prev = readJson(statusPath(), {}) || {}; } catch (_) { prev = {}; }
  const failing = lines.filter((l) => !OK_CYCLE.includes(l.status));
  const next = {
    lastCycle: {
      ts: now, status, ms, repos: lines.length,
      calls: lines.reduce((n, l) => n + (Number(l.calls) || 0), 0),
      newEvents: lines.reduce((n, l) => n + (Number(l.newEvents) || 0), 0),
      committed: lines.filter((l) => l.committed).length
    },
    lastOk: status === 'ok' || status === 'paused' ? now : prev.lastOk || null,
    lastFailed: status === 'failed'
      ? { ts: now, reason: error || (failing[0] && (failing[0].status + (failing[0].error ? ': ' + failing[0].error : ''))) || 'failed' }
      : prev.lastFailed || null,
    nextExpected: isoLocal(Date.now() + Number(cfg.intervalMinutes || 15) * 60000)
  };
  try { writeJsonAtomic(statusPath(), next); } catch (_) { /* status is advisory only */ }
  return next;
}

function fmtLine(l) {
  const bits = [l.repo.padEnd(24), 'events ' + l.newEvents, 'jobs ' + l.jobs, 'calls ' + l.calls];
  if (l.committed) bits.push('commit ' + l.committed);
  bits.push(l.status);
  if (l.error) bits.push('— ' + l.error);
  return '  ' + bits.join(' · ');
}

async function command(argv = []) {
  const quiet = argv.includes('--quiet');
  const res = await runCycle();
  if (!quiet) {
    if (res.status === 'skipped') process.stdout.write('another cycle is running — skipped\n');
    else if (res.status === 'paused') process.stdout.write('MEMO is paused — nothing ran (memo resume)\n');
    else {
      process.stdout.write('cycle ' + res.status + ' in ' + res.ms + ' ms\n');
      for (const l of res.repos) process.stdout.write(fmtLine(l) + '\n');
      if (res.repos.length === 0) process.stdout.write('  no registered repos — run `memo init` in a repo\n');
    }
  }
  return res;
}

module.exports = { command, runCycle, runRepo, writeStatus, statusPath, lockPath, LOCK_STALE_MS, OK_CYCLE };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo status`, `memo doctor`, `memo pause`, `memo resume` (P4).
// Everything here reads local state only; `memo doctor --live` is the one exception.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');

const { memoHome, logsDir, claudeSettingsPath } = require('./paths');
const config = require('./config');
const repos = require('./repos');
const usage = require('./usage');
const sessions = require('./store/sessions');
const cycle = require('./cycle');
const { fwd, readJson, isoLocal } = require('./util');
const { isMemoHandler } = require('./capture/install-claude');

const TASK_NAME = 'MEMO Background Processor';
const FRESH_CYCLE_MIN = 30;

function display(ts) {
  return ts ? isoLocal(ts).slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ') : 'never';
}

function hhmm(ts) {
  return ts ? isoLocal(ts).slice(11, 16) : '—';
}

function minutesSince(ts) {
  const t = Date.parse(ts);
  return Number.isFinite(t) ? Math.round((Date.now() - t) / 60000) : null;
}

function readStatusFile() {
  try { return readJson(cycle.statusPath(), null); } catch (_) { return null; }
}

// Last `event: "repo"` line of each repo in cycles.jsonl (newest wins).
function lastRepoLines() {
  const byRepo = new Map();
  for (const file of [path.join(logsDir(), 'cycles.jsonl.1'), path.join(logsDir(), 'cycles.jsonl')]) {
    let raw;
    try { raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { continue; }
    for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
      if (!line.trim()) continue;
      let obj;
      try { obj = JSON.parse(line); } catch (_) { continue; }
      if (obj && obj.event === 'repo' && obj.repoId) byRepo.set(obj.repoId, obj);
    }
  }
  return byRepo;
}

// Windows only: is the scheduled task registered?
function taskRegistered() {
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return { ok: false, detail: 'not Windows — use cron with `memo cycle`' };
  try {
    execFileSync('schtasks', ['/query', '/tn', TASK_NAME], { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    return { ok: true, detail: 'task registered' };
  } catch (_) {
    return { ok: false, detail: 'task not found — run scripts/windows/install_memo.bat' };
  }
}

function claudeHooks() {
  const file = claudeSettingsPath();
  let settings;
  try { settings = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch (err) {
    return { ok: false, detail: err.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'no ' + fwd(file) : 'unreadable: ' + err.message };
  }
  const hooks = settings && settings.hooks && typeof settings.hooks === 'object' ? settings.hooks : {};
  const events = Object.keys(hooks).filter((e) => (Array.isArray(hooks[e]) ? hooks[e] : [])
    .some((g) => g && Array.isArray(g.hooks) && g.hooks.some(isMemoHandler)));
  return { ok: events.length > 0, detail: events.length > 0 ? 'hooks on ' + events.join(', ') : 'no MEMO hooks' };
}

function repoRows() {
  const byRepo = lastRepoLines();
  return repos.load().map((repo) => {
    let live = [];
    let unprocessed = 0;
    let fresh = false;
    try {
      live = sessions.liveEntries(repo.root);
      for (const e of live) unprocessed += Math.max(0, (Number(e.events) || 0) - (Number(e.processedThrough) || 0));
      fresh = fs.existsSync(path.join(repo.root, '.memory', 'PROJECT_STATE.md'));
    } catch (_) { /* repo folder may be gone */ }
    const last = byRepo.get(repo.id) || null;
    return {
      id: repo.id,
      name: path.basename(repo.root),
      root: repo.root,
      enabled: repo.enabled !== false,
      exists: fs.existsSync(repo.root),
      sessions: live.length,
      unprocessed,
      state: fresh ? (unprocessed === 0 ? 'fresh' : 'behind') : 'missing',
      lastCommit: last && last.committed ? last.committed : null,
      lastStatus: last ? last.status : 'never run',
      lastTs: last ? last.ts : null
    };
  });
}

function renderStatus(cfg = config.load()) {
  const st = readStatusFile();
  const task = taskRegistered();
  const key = config.apiKey(cfg);
  const month = usage.monthTotals();
  const lines = [];

  const head = task.ok ? 'Running (task registered' + (st && st.nextExpected ? ', next ≈ ' + hhmm(st.nextExpected) : '') + ')'
    : 'Not scheduled (run install_memo.bat)';
  lines.push('MEMO  ' + head + '   API: ' + cfg.provider + '/' + cfg.model + ' key ' +
    (key ? 'set' : 'MISSING') + '   Paused: ' + (cfg.paused ? 'yes' : 'no'));

  const last = st && st.lastCycle ? st.lastCycle : null;
  const failed = st && st.lastFailed ? st.lastFailed : null;
  lines.push('Last cycle ' + (last ? display(last.ts) + ' ' + last.status + ' (' + last.ms + ' ms)' : 'never') +
    ' · last failure ' + (failed ? display(failed.ts) + ' ' + failed.reason : 'none'));
  lines.push('This month: ' + month.calls + ' calls · ' + (month.input / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M in / ' +
    (month.output / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M out · ≈ $' + month.costUsd.toFixed(2) +
    (month.costKnown ? '' : '+ (some models unpriced)') + ' of $' + cfg.monthlyBudgetUsd + ' budget');

  const rows = repoRows();
  lines.push('Repos:');
  if (rows.length === 0) lines.push('  (none registered — run `memo init` in a repo)');
  for (const r of rows.slice(0, 8)) {
    lines.push('  ' + r.name.padEnd(24) + ' sessions ' + r.sessions + ' · unprocessed ' + r.unprocessed +
      ' · last commit ' + (r.lastCommit ? r.lastCommit + ' ' + hhmm(r.lastTs) : '—') +
      ' · state ' + r.state + (r.enabled ? '' : ' · disabled') + (r.exists ? '' : ' · FOLDER MISSING'));
  }
  if (rows.length > 8) lines.push('  … ' + (rows.length - 8) + ' more');
  lines.push('Logs: ' + fwd(logsDir()));
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function nodeMajor() {
  return Number(String(process.versions.node).split('.')[0]) || 0;
}

function gitVersion() {
  try {
    return execFileSync('git', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true }).trim();
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function gitIdentity(root) {
  for (const key of ['user.name', 'user.email']) {
    try {
      const v = execFileSync('git', ['config', key], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true }).trim();
      if (!v) return false;
    } catch (_) { return false; }
  }
  return true;
}

function writable(dir) {
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const probe = path.join(dir, '.memo-write-probe');
    fs.writeFileSync(probe, 'x');
    fs.unlinkSync(probe);
    return true;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * All doctor checks. Returns [{ok, name, detail, fix}].
 * @param {boolean} live also make one cheap provider call
 */
async function checks(cfg = config.load(), { live = false } = {}) {
  const out = [];
  const add = (ok, name, detail, fix) => out.push({ ok, name, detail, fix: ok ? null : fix || null });

  add(nodeMajor() >= 20, 'node', 'v' + process.versions.node, 'install Node 20+ (winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS)');
  const git = gitVersion();
  add(Boolean(git), 'git', git || 'not found', 'install Git and reopen the terminal');
  add(writable(memoHome()), 'memo home', fwd(memoHome()), 'check folder permissions or set MEMO_HOME');

  const list = repos.load();
  add(list.length > 0, 'repos', list.length + ' registered', 'run `memo init` inside a repo');
  for (const repo of list) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(repo.root)) {
      add(false, 'repo ' + path.basename(repo.root), 'folder missing', 'remove it from ' + fwd(repos.registryPath()));
      continue;
    }
    add(gitIdentity(repo.root), 'identity ' + path.basename(repo.root), 'git user.name / user.email',
      'git -C "' + repo.root + '" config user.email you@example.com');
  }

  const hooks = claudeHooks();
  add(hooks.ok, 'claude hooks', hooks.detail, 'run `memo setup claude`');

  const key = config.apiKey(cfg);
  add(Boolean(key), 'api key', config.keyEnvName(cfg) + ' → ' + config.maskKey(key),
    'setx ' + cfg.apiKeyEnv + ' "<your key>" then reopen the terminal');
  add(Boolean(config.priceFor(cfg, cfg.model)), 'price', 'prices.' + cfg.model,
    'memo config set prices.' + cfg.model + '.inPerM <usd>');
  add(cfg.paused !== true, 'paused', cfg.paused ? 'paused' : 'no', 'memo resume');

  const task = taskRegistered();
  add(task.ok, 'scheduled task', task.detail, 'run scripts/windows/install_memo.bat');

  const st = readStatusFile();
  const age = st && st.lastCycle ? minutesSince(st.lastCycle.ts) : null;
  add(age !== null && age <= FRESH_CYCLE_MIN, 'last cycle',
    age === null ? 'never ran' : age + ' min ago (' + st.lastCycle.status + ')', 'run `memo cycle` once');

  if (live) {
    if (!key) add(false, 'api ping', 'skipped — no key', 'set the key first');
    else {
      const provider = require('./llm/provider');
      try {
        const res = await provider.create(cfg).complete({
          system: 'Reply with the single word: ok',
          user: 'ping', maxTokens: 8
        });
        usage.record({ repoId: null, job: 'doctor', model: res.model, in: res.usage.input, out: res.usage.output,
          costEst: usage.costOf(cfg, res.model, res.usage.input, res.usage.output) });
        add(true, 'api ping', cfg.provider + '/' + res.model + ' answered');
      } catch (err) {
        add(false, 'api ping', (err && err.kind ? err.kind + ': ' : '') + (err && err.message), 'check key, model name and network');
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function renderDoctor(results) {
  const lines = results.map((r) => (r.ok ? 'PASS  ' : 'FAIL  ') + r.name.padEnd(22) + ' ' + r.detail +
    (r.ok ? '' : '\n      fix: ' + r.fix));
  const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok).length;
  lines.push(failed === 0 ? 'all ' + results.length + ' checks passed' : failed + ' of ' + results.length + ' checks failed');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

async function doctorCommand(argv = []) {
  const results = await checks(config.load(), { live: argv.includes('--live') });
  process.stdout.write(renderDoctor(results));
  if (results.some((r) => !r.ok)) process.exitCode = 1;
  return results;
}

function statusCommand() {
  process.stdout.write(renderStatus());
}

function pauseCommand(paused) {
  const { cfg, changed } = config.set('paused', paused ? 'true' : 'false');
  process.stdout.write((paused ? 'paused' : 'resumed') + (changed ? '' : ' (already)') +
    ' — the scheduled task stays registered; next cycle ' + (cfg.paused ? 'will do nothing' : 'runs normally') + '\n');
  return cfg;
}

module.exports = {
  statusCommand, doctorCommand, pauseCommand, renderStatus, renderDoctor, checks,
  repoRows, lastRepoLines, taskRegistered, claudeHooks, display, TASK_NAME
};
```

```text
'use strict';

// Provider interface + factory + shared retry logic (P2 spec).
//
//   complete({system, user, maxTokens, model}) → {text, usage:{input, output}, model, requestId}
//
// Throws ProviderError{kind: 'retryable'|'auth'|'bad_request'|'quota'}.
// Never logs headers, bodies, or the API key — only status, requestId, attempt.

const { log } = require('../log');
const { sleepMs } = require('../util');

const TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;
const BACKOFF_MS = [2000, 8000, 30000];
const ATTEMPTS = 3;

class ProviderError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { kind = 'retryable', status = null, retryAfterMs = null, requestId = null } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ProviderError';
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.retryAfterMs = retryAfterMs;
    this.requestId = requestId;
  }
}

// HTTP status → error kind. Quota needs the body text, so it is decided by the caller.
function kindForStatus(status) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return 'auth';
  if (status === 429) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 413) return 'bad_request';
  if (status >= 500) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 408 || status === 409) return 'retryable';
  if (status >= 400) return 'bad_request';
  return 'retryable';
}

function retryAfterMs(headers) {
  if (!headers || typeof headers.get !== 'function') return null;
  const raw = headers.get('retry-after');
  if (!raw) return null;
  const seconds = Number(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(120, seconds)) * 1000;
  const when = Date.parse(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(when)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(120000, when - Date.now()));
  return null;
}

// Some hosts report a per-minute token limit as 413 instead of 429: that is retryable.
function looksLikeRateLimit(status, bodyText) {
  if (status !== 413) return false;
  return /tokens per minute|rate limit|tpm|too large for model/i.test(String(bodyText || ''));
}

// Body text often carries the only signal that credits ran out.
function looksLikeQuota(status, bodyText) {
  const text = String(bodyText || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!text) return false;
  const quota = /insufficient[_ -]?(quota|credit)|credit balance|billing|exceeded your current quota|payment required/.test(text);
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo install` — first-run setup called by scripts/windows/install_memo.bat (P4).
// Creates ~/.memo with a default config, installs the Claude Code hooks and prints
// the privacy notice. Secrets are never read, written or printed here.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const readline = require('node:readline');

const { memoHome, logsDir } = require('./paths');
const config = require('./config');
const { fwd } = require('./util');
const { setupClaude } = require('./capture/install-claude');

const PRIVACY = [
  'What MEMO captures and where it goes',
  '  captured  your Claude Code prompts, assistant replies, tool names, file paths and',
  '            trimmed tool output for repos you ran `memo init` in',
  '  dropped   thinking blocks, file contents, image blocks and anything matching denyPaths',
  '  stored    .memory/ inside that repo (committed to Git) and ~/.memo/ on this machine only',
  '  sent      batches of those events to the configured API provider for extraction',
  '  not sent  anything from unregistered repos; nothing while `memo pause` is on',
  '  stop it   `memo pause`, or uninstall_memo.bat, or `memo setup claude --remove`',
  '  delete it `memo clear --session <id>` / `--date <YYYY-MM-DD>` / `--all-repo-data`',
  '  warning   redaction is regex-based. Read .memory/ once before you push it anywhere.'
];

function ask(rl, question, fallback) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    rl.question(question + (fallback ? ' [' + fallback + ']' : '') + ': ', (answer) => {
      resolve(String(answer || '').trim() || fallback);
    });
  });
}

function flag(argv, name) {
  const i = argv.indexOf(name);
  return i !== -1 && argv[i + 1] && !argv[i + 1].startsWith('--') ? argv[i + 1] : null;
}

async function install(argv = []) {
  const out = [];
  fs.mkdirSync(memoHome(), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(logsDir(), { recursive: true });
  const existed = fs.existsSync(config.configPath());
  let cfg = config.ensure();
  out.push((existed ? 'kept     ' : 'created  ') + fwd(config.configPath()));

  let provider = flag(argv, '--provider');
  let model = flag(argv, '--model');
  const interactive = !argv.includes('--yes') && process.stdin.isTTY && (!provider || !model);

  if (interactive) {
    const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
    try {
      provider = provider || await ask(rl, 'provider (' + config.PROVIDERS.join('/') + ')', cfg.provider);
      model = model || await ask(rl, 'model id', cfg.model);
    } finally {
      rl.close();
    }
  }
  if (provider && provider !== cfg.provider) {
    cfg = config.set('provider', provider).cfg;
    out.push('set      provider ' + cfg.provider);
  }
  if (model && model !== cfg.model) {
    cfg = config.set('model', model).cfg;
    out.push('set      model ' + cfg.model);
  }

  process.stdout.write(out.join('\n') + '\n');
  setupClaude(argv.includes('--dry-run') ? ['--dry-run'] : []);

  process.stdout.write('\n' + PRIVACY.join('\n') + '\n\n');
  const key = config.apiKey(cfg);
  process.stdout.write('api key  ' + config.keyEnvName(cfg) + ' → ' + config.maskKey(key) + '\n');
  if (!key) {
    process.stdout.write('         set it with:  setx ' + cfg.apiKeyEnv + ' "<your key>"   (then reopen the terminal)\n');
  }
  if (!config.priceFor(cfg, cfg.model)) {
    process.stdout.write('price    unknown for ' + cfg.model + ' — memo config set prices.' + cfg.model + '.inPerM <usd>\n');
  }
  process.stdout.write('next     run `memo doctor`, then `memo cycle` once\n');
  return cfg;
}

module.exports = { install, PRIVACY };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo clear` — plan and apply deletion of captured data (P5).
// Dry run by default: nothing is touched until applyDelete runs.
// Deletion is honest: current files lose the data, older Git commits still hold it.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const { memoryDir, stateDir } = require('./paths');
const sessions = require('./store/sessions');
const records = require('./store/records');
const repos = require('./repos');
const brief = require('./brief');
const memoryCommit = require('./gitops/memory-commit');
const { fwd, readJson, writeJsonAtomic, writeFileAtomic, isoLocal } = require('./util');

const DATE_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const EVENT_ID_RE = /^e-[0-9a-f]{8}$/;
const HISTORY_NOTE =
  'Removed from current files and committed. Older Git commits still contain this data. ' +
  'Copies on GitHub/other clones are not affected. Full erasure needs history rewriting (not done by MEMO).';

function statBytes(file) {
  try { return fs.statSync(file).size; } catch (_) { return null; }
}

function fileEntry(root, abs) {
  const bytes = statBytes(abs);
  if (bytes === null) return null;
  return { path: abs, rel: fwd(path.relative(root, abs)), bytes };
}

function labelOf(rec) {
  const text = String((rec.type === 'task' && rec.title) || rec.statement || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  return text.length > 90 ? text.slice(0, 89) + '…' : text;
}

// Evidence entries that are captured events (record ids may also appear there).
function eventEvidence(rec) {
  return (Array.isArray(rec.evidence) ? rec.evidence : []).filter((id) => EVENT_ID_RE.test(String(id)));
}

// Split records into "only this target produced it" and "also knows other sources".
function classifyRecords(root, { sids, eventIds }) {
  const sidSet = new Set(sids);
  const only = [];
  const mixed = [];
  for (const rec of records.foldAll(root)) {
    const evHits = eventEvidence(rec).filter((id) => eventIds.has(id));
    const sidHits = (Array.isArray(rec.sessions) ? rec.sessions : []).filter((s) => sidSet.has(s));
    if (evHits.length === 0 && sidHits.length === 0) continue;
    const otherEvidence = eventEvidence(rec).some((id) => !eventIds.has(id));
    const otherSessions = (Array.isArray(rec.sessions) ? rec.sessions : []).some((s) => !sidSet.has(s));
    const entry = { id: rec.id, type: rec.type, label: labelOf(rec), evidence: evHits, sessions: sidHits };
    if (otherEvidence || otherSessions) mixed.push(entry);
    else only.push(entry);
  }
  return { only, mixed };
}

function emptyPlan(scope, target) {
  return {
    scope, target, sids: [], files: [], eventIds: new Set(),
    remove: [], strip: [], warnings: [], bytes: 0, withDerived: false, error: null
  };
}

function addSession(root, plan, entry) {
  plan.sids.push(entry.sid);
  for (const abs of [sessions.sessionFile(root, entry.date, entry.sid), sessions.summaryFile(root, entry.date, entry.sid)]) {
    const f = fileEntry(root, abs);
    if (f) { plan.files.push(f); plan.bytes += f.bytes; }
  }
  for (const id of sessions.readEventIds(sessions.sessionFile(root, entry.date, entry.sid))) plan.eventIds.add(id);
}

/**
 * Build a deletion plan. Nothing is written.
 * @param {string} root repo root
 * @param {object} opts {scope, value, withDerived}
 */
function planDelete(root, { scope, value, withDerived = false } = {}) {
  const plan = emptyPlan(scope, value);
  plan.withDerived = Boolean(withDerived);

  if (scope === 'session') {
    const found = sessions.resolveSid(root, String(value || ''));
    if (found.error) { plan.error = found.error; return plan; }
    plan.target = found.entry.sid;
    addSession(root, plan, found.entry);
  } else if (scope === 'date') {
    if (!DATE_RE.test(String(value || ''))) { plan.error = 'date must be YYYY-MM-DD'; return plan; }
    const list = sessions.liveEntries(root).filter((e) => e.date === value);
    if (list.length === 0) { plan.error = 'no sessions on ' + value; return plan; }
    for (const entry of list) addSession(root, plan, entry);
  } else if (scope === 'record') {
    const rec = records.byId(root).get(String(value || ''));
    if (!rec) { plan.error = 'no record with id ' + value; return plan; }
    plan.remove.push({ id: rec.id, type: rec.type, label: labelOf(rec), evidence: [], sessions: [] });
    plan.withDerived = true;
    return plan;
  } else if (scope === 'all-repo-data') {
    for (const entry of sessions.liveEntries(root)) addSession(root, plan, entry);
    for (const type of records.TYPE_NAMES) {
      const f = fileEntry(root, records.filePath(root, type));
      if (f) { plan.files.push(f); plan.bytes += f.bytes; }
    }
    const idx = fileEntry(root, sessions.indexPath(root));
    if (idx) { plan.files.push(idx); plan.bytes += idx.bytes; }
    plan.remove = records.foldAll(root).map((r) => ({ id: r.id, type: r.type, label: labelOf(r), evidence: [], sessions: [] }));
    plan.withDerived = true;
    plan.warnings.push('legacy/ notes and progress.md are kept');
    return plan;
  } else {
    plan.error = 'unknown scope: ' + scope;
    return plan;
  }

  const { only, mixed } = classifyRecords(root, { sids: plan.sids, eventIds: plan.eventIds });
  if (plan.withDerived) {
    plan.remove = only;
    plan.strip = mixed;
  } else {
    plan.strip = only.concat(mixed);
    if (only.length > 0) plan.warnings.push(only.length + ' record(s) come only from this data — add --with-derived to delete them too');
  }
  if (plan.files.length === 0) plan.warnings.push('no session files found on disk (index entry only)');
  return plan;
}

function renderPlan(plan) {
  const lines = ['clear ' + plan.scope + ' ' + (plan.target || '') + (plan.withDerived ? '  --with-derived' : '')];
  if (plan.error) return lines.concat(['! ' + plan.error]).join('\n') + '\n';
  lines.push('sessions  ' + (plan.sids.length ? plan.sids.map((s) => s.slice(0, 8)).join(', ') : '(none)'));
  lines.push('files     ' + plan.files.length + ' · ' + Math.round(plan.bytes / 1024) + ' KB');
  for (const f of plan.files.slice(0, 20)) lines.push('  - ' + f.rel + '  (' + f.bytes + ' B)');
  if (plan.files.length > 20) lines.push('  … ' + (plan.files.length - 20) + ' more');
  lines.push('records deleted  ' + plan.remove.length);
  for (const r of plan.remove.slice(0, 20)) lines.push('  - ' + r.id + ' ' + r.type + ' · ' + r.label);
  if (plan.remove.length > 20) lines.push('  … ' + (plan.remove.length - 20) + ' more');
  lines.push('records kept, evidence stripped  ' + plan.strip.length);
  for (const r of plan.strip.slice(0, 20)) {
    lines.push('  - ' + r.id + ' ' + r.type + ' · ' + r.label +
      (r.evidence.length ? ' · drops ' + r.evidence.join(', ') : ''));
  }
  if (plan.strip.length > 20) lines.push('  … ' + (plan.strip.length - 20) + ' more');
  for (const w of plan.warnings) lines.push('note: ' + w);
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// Rewrite one record op-log without the removed ids and without the dropped evidence.
function rewriteRecordFile(root, type, { removeIds, stripIds, eventIds, sids }) {
  const file = records.filePath(root, type);
  let raw;
  try { raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return 0;
    throw err;
  }
  const out = [];
  let changed = 0;
  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    let obj;
    try { obj = JSON.parse(line); } catch (_) { out.push(line); continue; }
    if (obj && removeIds.has(obj.id)) { changed++; continue; }
    if (obj && stripIds.has(obj.id)) {
      let touched = false;
      for (const field of ['evidence', 'completion_evidence']) {
        if (!Array.isArray(obj[field])) continue;
        const kept = obj[field].filter((id) => !eventIds.has(id));
        if (kept.length !== obj[field].length) { obj[field] = kept; touched = true; }
      }
      if (Array.isArray(obj.sessions)) {
        const kept = obj.sessions.filter((s) => !sids.has(s));
        if (kept.length !== obj.sessions.length) { obj.sessions = kept; touched = true; }
      }
      if (touched) { obj.source_deleted = true; changed++; }
      out.push(JSON.stringify(obj));
      continue;
    }
    out.push(line);
  }
  if (changed === 0) return 0;
  writeFileAtomic(file, out.length ? out.join('\n') + '\n' : '');
  return changed;
}

function dropCursors(root, sids) {
  const repo = repos.find(root);
  if (!repo) return 0;
  const file = path.join(stateDir(repo.id), 'cursors.json');
  let cursors;
  try { cursors = readJson(file, null); } catch (_) { return 0; }
  if (!cursors || typeof cursors !== 'object') return 0;
  let dropped = 0;
  for (const sid of sids) {
    if (cursors[sid]) { delete cursors[sid]; dropped++; }
  }
  if (dropped > 0) writeJsonAtomic(file, cursors);
  return dropped;
}

function rmDirIfEmpty(dir, stopAt) {
  let cur = dir;
  while (cur.startsWith(stopAt) && cur !== stopAt) {
    try {
      if (fs.readdirSync(cur).length > 0) return;
      fs.rmdirSync(cur);
    } catch (_) { return; }
    cur = path.dirname(cur);
  }
}

/**
 * Apply a plan: delete files, tombstone sessions, rewrite records, re-render, commit.
 * @returns {{filesDeleted, recordsDeleted, recordsStripped, commit, note}}
 */
function applyDelete(root, plan, { commit = true, cfg } = {}) {
  if (plan.error) throw new Error(plan.error);
  const when = isoLocal();
  const result = { filesDeleted: 0, recordsDeleted: 0, recordsStripped: 0, commit: null, note: HISTORY_NOTE };

  if (plan.scope === 'all-repo-data') {
    for (const dir of [sessions.sessionFile(root, '2000-01-01', 'x').split(path.sep + '2000')[0], records.recordsDir(root)]) {
      fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(memoryDir(root), 'sessions'), { recursive: true });
    sessions.saveIndex(root, []);
    records.ensureDir(root);
    result.filesDeleted = plan.files.length;
    result.recordsDeleted = plan.remove.length;
    dropCursors(root, plan.sids);
  } else {
    for (const f of plan.files) {
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(f.path);
        result.filesDeleted++;
        rmDirIfEmpty(path.dirname(f.path), path.join(memoryDir(root), 'sessions'));
      } catch (err) {
        if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') throw err;
      }
    }
    for (const sid of plan.sids) sessions.tombstone(root, sid, when);
    dropCursors(root, plan.sids);

    const removeIds = new Set(plan.remove.map((r) => r.id));
    const stripIds = new Set(plan.strip.map((r) => r.id));
    const types = new Set([...plan.remove, ...plan.strip].map((r) => r.type));
    for (const type of types) {
      rewriteRecordFile(root, type, { removeIds, stripIds, eventIds: plan.eventIds, sids: new Set(plan.sids) });
    }
    result.recordsDeleted = removeIds.size;
    result.recordsStripped = stripIds.size;
  }

  brief.report(root);

  if (commit) {
    const scopeText = plan.scope === 'session' ? 'session ' + String(plan.target).slice(0, 8)
      : plan.scope === 'date' ? String(plan.target)
        : plan.scope === 'record' ? 'record ' + plan.target
          : 'this repo';
    result.commit = memoryCommit.commitMemory(root, {
      ...(cfg ? { cfg } : {}),
      message: 'memo: remove captured session data for ' + scopeText
    });
  }
  return result;
}

module.exports = { planDelete, renderPlan, applyDelete, classifyRecords, rewriteRecordFile, HISTORY_NOTE, DATE_RE };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo sessions`, `memo show`, `memo tasks` — read-only views of .memory/ (P5).
// Pure renderers so the menu and the CLI print exactly the same screens.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
const sessions = require('./store/sessions');
const records = require('./store/records');
const state = require('./report/state');
const { classifyRecords } = require('./delete');
const { fwd } = require('./util');

function bytesOf(file) {
  try { return fs.statSync(file).size; } catch (_) { return 0; }
}

function sessionBytes(root, entry) {
  return bytesOf(sessions.sessionFile(root, entry.date, entry.sid)) +
    bytesOf(sessions.summaryFile(root, entry.date, entry.sid));
}

function kb(n) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1024)) + ' KB';
}

// Dates that have sessions, newest first.
function listDates(root) {
  const byDate = new Map();
  for (const e of sessions.liveEntries(root)) {
    const row = byDate.get(e.date) || { date: e.date, sessions: 0, events: 0, bytes: 0 };
    row.sessions++;
    row.events += Number(e.events) || 0;
    row.bytes += sessionBytes(root, e);
    byDate.set(e.date, row);
  }
  return [...byDate.values()].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
}

function listSessions(root, date) {
  return sessions.liveEntries(root)
    .filter((e) => !date || e.date === date)
    .sort((a, b) => String(b.start || '').localeCompare(String(a.start || '')));
}

function renderDates(root) {
  const rows = listDates(root);
  const lines = ['Dates with captured sessions'];
  if (rows.length === 0) lines.push('  (none yet)');
  for (const r of rows.slice(0, 20)) {
    lines.push('  ' + r.date + '   ' + String(r.sessions).padStart(3) + ' session(s) · ' +
      String(r.events).padStart(5) + ' events · ' + kb(r.bytes));
  }
  if (rows.length > 20) lines.push('  … ' + (rows.length - 20) + ' more');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function renderSessions(root, date) {
  const rows = listSessions(root, date);
  const lines = ['Sessions' + (date ? ' on ' + date : '')];
  if (rows.length === 0) lines.push('  (none)');
  for (const e of rows.slice(0, 25)) {
    const events = Number(e.events) || 0;
    const done = Number(e.processedThrough) || 0;
    lines.push('  ' + String(e.start || '').slice(11, 16).padEnd(5) + ' · ' + e.sid.slice(0, 8) + ' · ' +
      String(e.agent || 'claude-code').padEnd(11) + ' · ' + String(events).padStart(4) + ' events · ' +
      (done >= events ? 'processed' : done + '/' + events).padEnd(9) + ' · ' + state.oneLine(e.summary || '', 60));
  }
  if (rows.length > 25) lines.push('  … ' + (rows.length - 25) + ' more');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// Summary text, file paths and the records this session produced.
function renderShow(root, wanted) {
  const found = sessions.resolveSid(root, String(wanted || ''));
  if (found.error) return found.error + '\n';
  const e = found.entry;
  const jsonl = sessions.sessionFile(root, e.date, e.sid);
  const md = sessions.summaryFile(root, e.date, e.sid);
  const eventIds = new Set(sessions.readEventIds(jsonl));
  const { only, mixed } = classifyRecords(root, { sids: [e.sid], eventIds });

  const lines = [
    'Session ' + e.sid.slice(0, 8) + ' · ' + e.date + ' · ' + (e.agent || 'claude-code'),
    'events ' + (Number(e.events) || 0) + ' · processed ' + (Number(e.processedThrough) || 0) +
      ' · status ' + (e.status || 'unknown') + ' · ' + kb(sessionBytes(root, e)),
    'events file  ' + fwd(path.relative(root, jsonl)),
    'summary file ' + fwd(path.relative(root, md)) + (fs.existsSync(md) ? '' : ' (not written yet)'),
    ''
  ];
  let summary = '';
  try { summary = fs.readFileSync(md, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { summary = ''; }
  if (summary) lines.push(summary.trimEnd(), '');
  else lines.push(e.summary ? e.summary : '(no summary yet — run `memo process`)', '');

  lines.push('Records from this session only (' + only.length + ')');
  for (const r of only) lines.push('  - ' + r.id + ' ' + r.type + ' · ' + r.label);
  if (only.length === 0) lines.push('  (none)');
  lines.push('Records that also cite other sources (' + mixed.length + ')');
  for (const r of mixed) lines.push('  - ' + r.id + ' ' + r.type + ' · ' + r.label);
  if (mixed.length === 0) lines.push('  (none)');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

const OPEN = ['open', 'in_progress', 'blocked'];

function renderTasks(root, { all = false } = {}) {
  const tasks = records.foldAll(root).filter((r) => r.type === 'task');
  const shown = (all ? tasks : tasks.filter((t) => OPEN.includes(t.status) || t.status === 'implemented_unverified'))
    .sort(state.byPriorityAge);
  const lines = ['Tasks' + (all ? ' (all)' : ' (open, in progress, blocked, implemented but unverified)')];
  if (shown.length === 0) lines.push('  (none)');
  for (const t of shown.slice(0, 40)) {
    lines.push('  ' + t.id + ' · ' + String(t.priority || 'unranked').padEnd(8) + ' · ' +
      String(t.status).padEnd(22) + ' · ' + String(t.effort_estimate || '?').padEnd(6) + ' · ' + state.label(t));
  }
  if (shown.length > 40) lines.push('  … ' + (shown.length - 40) + ' more');
  lines.push('Full table: .memory/TASKS.md');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function currentRoot(argv = []) {
  const i = argv.indexOf('--repo');
  return repoRoot(i !== -1 && argv[i + 1] ? path.resolve(argv[i + 1]) : process.cwd());
}

function sessionsCommand(argv = []) {
  const root = currentRoot(argv);
  const i = argv.indexOf('--date');
  const date = i !== -1 ? argv[i + 1] : null;
  process.stdout.write(date ? renderSessions(root, date) : renderDates(root));
}

function showCommand(argv = []) {
  const root = currentRoot(argv);
  const sid = argv.find((a) => !a.startsWith('--'));
  if (!sid) throw new Error('usage: memo show <sid8|sid>');
  process.stdout.write(renderShow(root, sid));
}

function tasksCommand(argv = []) {
  process.stdout.write(renderTasks(currentRoot(argv), { all: argv.includes('--all') }));
}

module.exports = {
  listDates, listSessions, renderDates, renderSessions, renderShow, renderTasks,
  sessionsCommand, showCommand, tasksCommand, currentRoot
};
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo console` — numbered terminal menu over the same functions the CLI uses (P5).
// Rendering is pure (testable); only run() touches readline.

const readline = require('node:readline');
const path = require('node:path');

const { repoRoot } = require('../git');
const config = require('../config');
const status = require('../status');
const browse = require('../browse');
const del = require('../delete');
const cycle = require('../cycle');

const ITEMS = [
  ['1', 'Status'],
  ['2', 'Browse by date'],
  ['3', 'Tasks'],
  ['4', 'Clear data'],
  ['5', 'Pause / Resume'],
  ['6', 'Run cycle now'],
  ['0', 'Exit']
];

function renderMenu(cfg = config.load(), root = null) {
  const lines = ['', 'MEMO console' + (root ? '  —  ' + path.basename(root) : '') +
    (cfg.paused ? '   [PAUSED]' : '')];
  for (const [key, label] of ITEMS) lines.push('  ' + key + '  ' + label);
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

const CLEAR_MENU = [
  ['1', 'one session'],
  ['2', 'one whole date'],
  ['3', 'one record id'],
  ['0', 'back']
];

function renderClearMenu() {
  const lines = ['', 'Clear data — dry run first, nothing is deleted until you type DELETE'];
  for (const [key, label] of CLEAR_MENU) lines.push('  ' + key + '  ' + label);
  lines.push('  History note: ' + del.HISTORY_NOTE);
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// Git history is never rewritten by MEMO; the menu says so instead of pretending.
function renderPurgeNote() {
  return 'MEMO never rewrites Git history. To erase data from old commits you would run\n' +
    '`git filter-repo` yourself and force-push — that rewrites every commit id and breaks clones.\n';
}

function ask(rl, question) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => rl.question(question, (a) => resolve(String(a || '').trim())));
}

async function clearFlow(rl, root, out) {
  out(renderClearMenu());
  const pick = await ask(rl, 'choice: ');
  if (pick === '0' || pick === '') return;
  let scope = null;
  let value = null;
  if (pick === '1') {
    out(browse.renderSessions(root));
    scope = 'session';
    value = await ask(rl, 'session id (8 chars is enough): ');
  } else if (pick === '2') {
    out(browse.renderDates(root));
    scope = 'date';
    value = await ask(rl, 'date (YYYY-MM-DD): ');
  } else if (pick === '3') {
    scope = 'record';
    value = await ask(rl, 'record id (e.g. T-1b2c3d4e): ');
  } else {
    out('unknown choice\n');
    return;
  }

  const withDerived = (await ask(rl, 'also delete records that come only from it? [y/N]: ')).toLowerCase() === 'y';
  const plan = del.planDelete(root, { scope, value, withDerived });
  out(del.renderPlan(plan));
  if (plan.error) return;
  if (scope === 'date') {
    const typed = await ask(rl, 'type the date again to confirm: ');
    if (typed !== value) { out('not confirmed — nothing deleted\n'); return; }
  }
  const confirm = await ask(rl, 'type DELETE to apply: ');
  if (confirm !== 'DELETE') { out('not confirmed — nothing deleted\n'); return; }
  const res = del.applyDelete(root, plan);
  out('deleted ' + res.filesDeleted + ' file(s), ' + res.recordsDeleted + ' record(s), stripped ' +
    res.recordsStripped + '\n' + (res.commit ? 'commit: ' + res.commit.status + (res.commit.hash ? ' ' + res.commit.hash : '') + '\n' : '') +
    res.note + '\n' + renderPurgeNote());
}

async function run({ input = process.stdin, output = process.stdout } = {}) {
  let root = null;
  try { root = repoRoot(process.cwd()); } catch (_) { root = null; }
  const out = (text) => output.write(text);
  if (!root) {
    out('not inside a git repo — cd into a repo that ran `memo init`\n');
    return 1;
  }
  const rl = readline.createInterface({ input, output });
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const cfg = config.load();
      out(renderMenu(cfg, root));
      const choice = await ask(rl, 'choice: ');
      if (choice === '0' || choice === 'q' || choice === '') break;
      if (choice === '1') out(status.renderStatus(cfg));
      else if (choice === '2') {
        out(browse.renderDates(root));
        const date = await ask(rl, 'date (blank = all): ');
        out(browse.renderSessions(root, date || null));
        const sid = await ask(rl, 'session id to open (blank = back): ');
        if (sid) out(browse.renderShow(root, sid));
      } else if (choice === '3') out(browse.renderTasks(root, { all: false }));
      else if (choice === '4') await clearFlow(rl, root, out);
      else if (choice === '5') status.pauseCommand(!cfg.paused);
      else if (choice === '6') {
        out('running one cycle…\n');
        const res = await cycle.runCycle();
        out('cycle ' + res.status + ' in ' + res.ms + ' ms\n');
      } else out('unknown choice\n');
    }
  } finally {
    rl.close();
  }
  return 0;
}

module.exports = { run, renderMenu, renderClearMenu, renderPurgeNote, ITEMS, CLEAR_MENU };
```

```bat
@echo off
setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion
title MEMO installer

for %%I in ("%HERE%..\..") do set "ROOT=%%~fI"
set "MEMOJS=%ROOT%\bin\memo.js"

echo repo: %ROOT%

if errorlevel 1 (

  echo        install it:  winget install --id Git.Git -e

  echo        install it:  winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e
  goto :fail
)

if !NODEMAJOR! LSS 20 (
  echo [FAIL] Node !NODEMAJOR! is too old, MEMO needs 20 or newer.
  echo        upgrade:  winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e
  goto :fail
)
for /f "delims=" %%p in ('node -e "process.stdout.write(process.execPath)"') do set "NODEEXE=%%p"
echo [ok] node !NODEMAJOR! at !NODEEXE!
echo.

echo --- setup (config, Claude Code hooks, privacy notice) ---
call node "%MEMOJS%" install
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] memo install failed.
  goto :fail
)
echo.

if defined MEMO_API_KEY (
  echo [ok] MEMO_API_KEY is already set in this session.
) else (
  echo MEMO_API_KEY is not set. It is stored in your Windows user environment
  echo ^(visible to programs running as you^) and is never written into the repo.
  set /p "WANTKEY=enter it now? [y/N]: "
  if /i "!WANTKEY!"=="y" (
    powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$s = Read-Host -AsSecureString 'API key (not echoed)'; $b=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($s); $p=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringAuto($b); [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($b); if ($p) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('MEMO_API_KEY', $p, 'User'); Write-Host '[ok] saved to user environment MEMO_API_KEY (reopen terminals to see it)' } else { Write-Host '[skip] nothing entered' }"
  ) else (
    echo [skip] set it later:  setx MEMO_API_KEY "your-key"
  )
)
echo.

echo --- scheduled task ---
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%HERE%register-task.ps1" -NodeExe "!NODEEXE!" -MemoJs "%MEMOJS%" -TaskName "%TASKNAME%"
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [warn] task registration failed. You can still run "memo cycle" by hand.
)

if /i "!WANTLINK!"=="y" (

)

call node "%MEMOJS%" doctor
echo.
call node "%MEMOJS%" cycle
echo.

echo.
echo Done. Useful next:
echo   memo status                 what MEMO did
echo   memo console                browse and delete captured data
echo   scripts\windows\uninstall_memo.bat
goto :done

:fail
echo.
echo Installation stopped. Nothing was scheduled.
endlocal
exit /b 1

:done
endlocal
exit /b 0
```

```ps1
#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
  Registers (or updates) the MEMO scheduled task for the current user. No admin rights needed.
  The task runs `node bin/memo.js cycle` every -IntervalMinutes and once at logon.

  Hidden launch: by default the action is wscript.exe run-hidden.vbs, which starts node with no
  console window at all. -HiddenMethod direct runs node.exe itself (a window may flash).
  docs/PHASE0_FINDINGS.md section 5 records which one was verified on this machine.
#>
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NodeExe,
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$MemoJs,
  [string]$TaskName = 'MEMO Background Processor',
  [int]$IntervalMinutes = 15,
  [ValidateSet('vbs', 'direct')][string]$HiddenMethod = 'vbs',
  [switch]$Remove
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Remove-MemoTask {
  param([string]$Name)
  $existing = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if ($existing) {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -Confirm:$false
    Write-Host "[ok] removed scheduled task '$Name'"
  } else {
    Write-Host "[skip] no scheduled task '$Name'"
  }
}

if ($Remove) {
  Remove-MemoTask -Name $TaskName
  $lnk = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'MEMO cycle.lnk'
  if (Test-Path $lnk) { Remove-Item $lnk -Force; Write-Host "[ok] removed startup shortcut" }
  exit 0
}

if (-not (Test-Path $NodeExe)) { throw "node not found at $NodeExe" }
if (-not (Test-Path $MemoJs)) { throw "memo.js not found at $MemoJs" }

$vbs = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'run-hidden.vbs'
if ($HiddenMethod -eq 'vbs' -and -not (Test-Path $vbs)) { throw "run-hidden.vbs missing next to this script" }

if ($HiddenMethod -eq 'vbs') {
  $exe = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\wscript.exe'
  $arguments = '//B //Nologo "{0}" "{1}" "{2}" cycle' -f $vbs, $NodeExe, $MemoJs
} else {
  $exe = $NodeExe
  $arguments = '"{0}" cycle' -f $MemoJs
}

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $exe -Argument $arguments -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $MemoJs -Parent)

$everyN = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At (Get-Date).AddMinutes(1) `
  -RepetitionInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes $IntervalMinutes) `
  -RepetitionDuration ([TimeSpan]::MaxValue)
$triggers = @($everyN)
try {
  $triggers += New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User ([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)
} catch {
  Write-Host "[warn] logon trigger not allowed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
}

$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -StartWhenAvailable `
  -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew `
  -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 10) `
  -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -DontStopOnIdleEnd
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId ([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name) -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited

$existing = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($existing) {
  Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggers -Settings $settings | Out-Null
  Write-Host "[ok] updated scheduled task '$TaskName' (every $IntervalMinutes min, $HiddenMethod launch)"
} else {
  Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggers -Settings $settings `
    -Principal $principal -Description 'MEMO: captures and summarises AI coding sessions into .memory/' | Out-Null
  Write-Host "[ok] registered scheduled task '$TaskName' (every $IntervalMinutes min, $HiddenMethod launch)"
}

if (-not ($triggers | Where-Object { $_.CimClass.CimClassName -eq 'MSFT_TaskLogonTrigger' })) {
  $startup = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')
  $shortcut = (New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut((Join-Path $startup 'MEMO cycle.lnk'))
  $shortcut.TargetPath = $exe
  $shortcut.Arguments = $arguments
  $shortcut.WindowStyle = 7
  $shortcut.Description = 'Run one MEMO cycle at logon'
  $shortcut.Save()
  Write-Host "[ok] startup shortcut written (logon trigger was unavailable)"
}
```

```vbs
' Start a program with no console window. Used by the MEMO scheduled task.
' usage: wscript //B //Nologo run-hidden.vbs "<exe>" [args...]
Option Explicit
Dim shell, args, cmd, i

  If i < args.Count - 1 Then cmd = cmd & " "
```

```text
=== mock provider
'use strict';

// Offline provider: replays canned responses from test/fixtures/llm/ and simulates failures.
// Used by `npm test` (no key, no network) and by `memo config set provider mock`.
//
// Script comes from MEMO_MOCK_LLM (comma-separated steps, one per complete() call) or
// setScript([...]). A step is either a fixture name under MEMO_MOCK_LLM_DIR or one of:
//   429 | 500 | timeout | auth | quota | bad_request | empty
// A fixture file is {"response": <object|string>, "usage": {input, output}, "model": "..."}.
// The last step repeats if more calls are made than the script has steps.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { ProviderError, withRetries } = require('./provider');

const FAILURES = {
  429: () => new ProviderError('mock 429 rate limited', { kind: 'retryable', status: 429, retryAfterMs: 0 }),
  500: () => new ProviderError('mock 500 server error', { kind: 'retryable', status: 500, retryAfterMs: 0 }),
  timeout: () => new ProviderError('mock request timed out', { kind: 'retryable', status: null, retryAfterMs: 0 }),
  auth: () => new ProviderError('mock 401 invalid key', { kind: 'auth', status: 401 }),
  quota: () => new ProviderError('mock credit balance too low', { kind: 'quota', status: 400 }),
  bad_request: () => new ProviderError('mock 400 bad request', { kind: 'bad_request', status: 400 })
};

let script = null;
let calls = [];

function setScript(steps) {
  script = Array.isArray(steps) ? steps.map(String) : null;
  calls = [];
}

function callLog() {
  return calls;
}

function fixturesDir() {
  return process.env.MEMO_MOCK_LLM_DIR || path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'test', 'fixtures', 'llm');
}

function steps() {
  if (script) return script;
  const raw = process.env.MEMO_MOCK_LLM;
  if (!raw || !raw.trim()) return ['empty'];
  return raw.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function loadFixture(name) {
  const safe = String(name).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '');
  const file = path.join(fixturesDir(), safe.endsWith('.json') ? safe : safe + '.json');
  const raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  const text = typeof parsed.response === 'string' ? parsed.response : JSON.stringify(parsed.response);
  return {
    text,
    usage: {
      input: Number(parsed.usage && parsed.usage.input) || 0,
      output: Number(parsed.usage && parsed.usage.output) || 0
    },
    model: parsed.model || 'mock'
  };
}

function create(cfg, opts = {}) {
  let index = 0;
  return {
    name: 'mock',
    model: cfg.model,
    calls,
    // Same retry wrapper as the real providers, but with no waiting.
    async complete({ system, user, maxTokens = 2000, model = cfg.model }) {
      return withRetries('mock', async () => {
        const list = steps();
        const step = list[Math.min(index, list.length - 1)];
        index++;
        calls.push({ step, system, user, maxTokens, model });
        if (FAILURES[step]) throw FAILURES[step]();
        if (step === 'empty') {
          return {
            text: JSON.stringify({ schema: 1, session_summary: '', items: [], gaps: [] }),
            usage: { input: Math.ceil((system.length + user.length) / 4), output: 20 },
            model: 'mock',
            requestId: 'mock-' + index
          };
        }
        const fixture = loadFixture(step);
        return {
          text: fixture.text,
          usage: {
            input: fixture.usage.input || Math.ceil((system.length + user.length) / 4),
            output: fixture.usage.output || Math.ceil(fixture.text.length / 4)
          },
          model: fixture.model,
          requestId: 'mock-' + index
        };
      }, { backoff: [0, 0, 0], sleep: () => {}, ...opts });
    }
  };
}

module.exports = { create, setScript, callLog, loadFixture, fixturesDir, FAILURES };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const { acquire } = require('../src/lock');

function tmp(t) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-lock-test-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return path.join(dir, 'nested', 'cycle.lock');
}

test('a free lock is taken and the file carries pid and start time', (t) => {
  const file = tmp(t);
  const lock = acquire(file);
  assert.ok(lock, 'expected the lock');
  assert.equal(lock.recovered, false);
  const body = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
  assert.equal(body.pid, process.pid);
  assert.match(body.startedAt, /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/);
  lock.release();
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(file), false);
});

test('a live lock makes the second caller skip', (t) => {
  const file = tmp(t);
  const first = acquire(file);
  assert.ok(first);
  assert.equal(acquire(file, { staleMs: 20 * 60 * 1000 }), null);
  first.release();
  const third = acquire(file);
  assert.ok(third);
  third.release();
});

test('a stale lock is taken over and reported as recovered', (t) => {
  const file = tmp(t);
  const first = acquire(file);
  assert.ok(first);
  const old = Date.now() - 25 * 60 * 1000;
  fs.utimesSync(file, new Date(old), new Date(old));
  const second = acquire(file, { staleMs: 20 * 60 * 1000 });
  assert.ok(second, 'a 25 min old lock must be recoverable');
  assert.equal(second.recovered, true);
  second.release();
});

test('release is idempotent and never throws', (t) => {
  const file = tmp(t);
  const lock = acquire(file);
  lock.release();
  lock.release();
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(file), false);
});
```

```javascript
  const before = gitLog(ctx.root).length;
  const started = Date.now();
  const r = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'decision' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.deepEqual(usageLines(ctx.home), []);
  assert.equal(gitLog(ctx.root).length, before);
  const repoLine = cycleLines(ctx.home).find((l) => l.event === 'repo');
  assert.equal(repoLine.status, 'no_new_data');
  assert.equal(repoLine.calls, 0);
  assert.ok(Date.now() - started < 10000, 'a no-op cycle must stay fast');
});

test('a live cycle lock makes the next cycle skip, a stale one is recovered', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const lock = path.join(ctx.home, 'cycle.lock');
  fs.writeFileSync(lock, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() }));

  const skipped = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'decision' });
  assert.equal(skipped.status, 0);
  assert.match(skipped.stdout, /another cycle is running/);
  assert.ok(cycleLines(ctx.home).some((l) => l.event === 'overlap_skip'));
  assert.deepEqual(usageLines(ctx.home), []);

  const old = Date.now() - 25 * 60 * 1000;
  fs.utimesSync(lock, new Date(old), new Date(old));
  const recovered = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'error-fixed-verified' });
  assert.equal(recovered.status, 0, recovered.stderr);
  assert.ok(cycleLines(ctx.home).some((l) => l.event === 'stale_lock_recovered'));
  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(lock), false, 'the lock is released at the end');
});

test('paused: nothing is captured, processed or committed', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t, { config: { paused: true } });
  const before = gitLog(ctx.root).length;
  const r = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'decision' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.match(r.stdout, /paused/);
  assert.deepEqual(usageLines(ctx.home), []);
  assert.equal(gitLog(ctx.root).length, before);
  assert.ok(cycleLines(ctx.home).some((l) => l.event === 'cycle_end' && l.status === 'paused'));
});

test('budget reached: no API call, but the raw events are still committed', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t, { config: { monthlyBudgetUsd: 0 } });
  // Put the events where capture --sweep has nothing to do but process does.
  const r = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'decision' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.deepEqual(usageLines(ctx.home), []);
  const repoLine = cycleLines(ctx.home).find((l) => l.event === 'repo');
  assert.equal(repoLine.status, 'budget_reached');
  assert.equal(repoLine.calls, 0);
  // PROJECT_STATE.md still lists the session, so the commit happened.
  assert.ok(gitLog(ctx.root).some((s) => /^memo: archive/.test(s)));
});

test('one broken repo does not stop the healthy one', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const broken = path.join(ctx.base, 'broken');
  fs.mkdirSync(broken, { recursive: true });
  const registry = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ctx.home, 'repos.json'), 'utf8'));
  registry.unshift({ id: 'broken-00000000', root: broken.replace(/\\/g, '/'), addedAt: '2026-10-21T00:00:00.000+05:30', enabled: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(ctx.home, 'repos.json'), JSON.stringify(registry, null, 2) + '\n');

  const r = ctx.memo(['cycle'], { MEMO_MOCK_LLM: 'error-fixed-verified' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  const lines = cycleLines(ctx.home).filter((l) => l.event === 'repo');
  assert.equal(lines.length, 2);
  assert.equal(lines.find((l) => l.repoId === 'broken-00000000').status, 'error');
  const healthy = lines.find((l) => l.repoId !== 'broken-00000000');
  assert.equal(healthy.status, 'ok');
  assert.ok(healthy.committed);
});
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// `memo status` / `memo doctor` render from local files only — no network, no key.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

function freshRequire() {
  for (const key of Object.keys(require.cache)) {
    if (key.includes(path.sep + 'src' + path.sep)) delete require.cache[key];
  }
  return {
    status: require('../src/status'),
    config: require('../src/config'),
    cycle: require('../src/cycle')
  };
}

function setup(t, { logs = [], statusJson = null, config: cfg = {}, repoRoot = null } = {}) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-status-test-'));
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(home, 'logs'), { recursive: true });
  const saved = { MEMO_HOME: process.env.MEMO_HOME, MEMO_CLAUDE_SETTINGS: process.env.MEMO_CLAUDE_SETTINGS };
  process.env.MEMO_HOME = home;
  process.env.MEMO_CLAUDE_SETTINGS = path.join(base, 'claude.json');
  t.after(() => {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(saved)) { if (v === undefined) delete process.env[k]; else process.env[k] = v; }
    fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
    freshRequire();
  });

  const root = repoRoot || path.join(base, 'my-repo');
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'PROJECT_STATE.md'), '# state\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), JSON.stringify([
    { sid: 'aaaaaaaa-1111-4222-8333-444444444444', agent: 'claude-code', date: '2026-10-21', events: 9, processedThrough: 9 },
    { sid: 'bbbbbbbb-1111-4222-8333-444444444444', agent: 'claude-code', date: '2026-10-21', events: 4, processedThrough: 1 },
    { sid: 'cccccccc-1111-4222-8333-444444444444', agent: 'claude-code', date: '2026-10-20', deletedAt: '2026-10-21T10:00:00.000+05:30' }
  ], null, 2));

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'repos.json'), JSON.stringify([
    { id: 'my-repo-12345678', root: root.replace(/\\/g, '/'), addedAt: '2026-10-20T10:00:00.000+05:30', enabled: true }
  ], null, 2));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'config.json'), JSON.stringify({ v: 1, provider: 'mock', model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', ...cfg }, null, 2));
  if (logs.length) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'logs', 'cycles.jsonl'), logs.map((l) => JSON.stringify(l)).join('\n') + '\n');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'logs', 'usage.jsonl'), [
    { ts: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + 'T10:00:00.000+05:30', model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', in: 120000, out: 9000, costEst: 0.0165 },
    { ts: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + 'T10:30:00.000+05:30', model: 'claude-haiku-5-5', in: 80000, out: 5000, costEst: 0.0105 }
  ].map((l) => JSON.stringify(l)).join('\n') + '\n');
  if (statusJson) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(home, 'status.json'), JSON.stringify(statusJson, null, 2));

  return { base, home, root, ...freshRequire() };
}

const NOW = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19) + '.000+00:00';

test('status renders from the logs in at most 20 lines', (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t, {
    logs: [
      { ts: NOW, event: 'cycle_start', status: 'running' },
      { ts: NOW, event: 'repo', repo: 'my-repo', repoId: 'my-repo-12345678', newEvents: 9, jobs: 1, calls: 1, committed: 'abc1234', status: 'ok', ms: 900 },
      { ts: NOW, event: 'cycle_end', status: 'ok', repos: 1, ms: 950 }
    ],
    statusJson: {
      lastCycle: { ts: NOW, status: 'ok', ms: 950, repos: 1, calls: 1, newEvents: 9, committed: 1 },
      lastOk: NOW, lastFailed: { ts: '2026-10-26T22:15:00.000+05:30', reason: 'api_failed: timeout' },
      nextExpected: NOW
    }
  });
  const text = ctx.status.renderStatus(ctx.config.load());
  const lines = text.trimEnd().split('\n');
  assert.ok(lines.length <= 20, 'status must stay short, got ' + lines.length);
  assert.match(lines[0], /^MEMO {2}/);
  assert.match(lines[0], /mock\/claude-haiku-5-5/);
  assert.match(lines[0], /Paused: no/);
  assert.match(text, /Last cycle .* ok/);
  assert.match(text, /last failure 2026-10-26 22:15 api_failed: timeout/);
  assert.match(text, /This month: 2 calls · 0\.20M in \/ 0\.01M out · ≈ \$0\.03 of \$5 budget/);
  assert.match(text, /my-repo {2,}sessions 2 · unprocessed 3 · last commit abc1234/);
  assert.match(text, /state behind/);
  assert.match(text, /Logs: /);
});

  const by = Object.fromEntries(results.map((r) => [r.name, r]));
  assert.equal(by.node.ok, true);
  assert.equal(by['claude hooks'].ok, false);
  assert.match(by['claude hooks'].fix, /memo setup claude/);
  assert.equal(by['last cycle'].ok, false, 'no cycle has run in this temp home');
  assert.equal(by.repos.ok, true);
  assert.equal(by.paused.ok, true);
  for (const r of results) {
    if (!r.ok) assert.ok(r.fix && r.fix.length > 0, r.name + ' needs a fix hint');
  }
  const rendered = ctx.status.renderDoctor(results);
  assert.match(rendered, /^(PASS|FAIL) {2}/m);
  assert.match(rendered, /checks (passed|failed)/);
});
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// The Windows launchers must stay CRLF and must not hide errors or echo secrets.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const DIR = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'scripts', 'windows');
const EXPECTED = ['install_memo.bat', 'uninstall_memo.bat', 'memo_status.bat', 'memo_console.bat',
  'register-task.ps1', 'run-hidden.vbs'];

test('every Windows launcher exists', () => {
  for (const name of EXPECTED) assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(DIR, name)), name + ' is missing');
});

test('.bat, .ps1 and .vbs files use CRLF line endings', () => {
  for (const name of EXPECTED) {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, name), 'latin1');
    const lf = (raw.match(/\n/g) || []).length;
    const crlf = (raw.match(/\r\n/g) || []).length;
    assert.ok(lf > 0, name + ' has no line breaks');
    assert.equal(crlf, lf, name + ' must be CRLF only (' + crlf + '/' + lf + ')');
  }
});

test('the installer checks node and git before touching anything', () => {
  const bat = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'install_memo.bat'), 'latin1');
  assert.match(bat, /where git/);
  assert.match(bat, /where node/);
  assert.match(bat, /NODEMAJOR! LSS 20/);
  assert.match(bat, /winget install/);
  assert.match(bat, /memo\.js" install/);
  assert.match(bat, /register-task\.ps1/);
  assert.match(bat, /doctor/);
});

test('the API key is read without echoing it and only written to the user environment', () => {
  const bat = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'install_memo.bat'), 'latin1');
  assert.match(bat, /Read-Host -AsSecureString/);
  assert.match(bat, /SetEnvironmentVariable\('MEMO_API_KEY'/);
  assert.equal(/set \/p *"?KEY=/i.test(bat), false, 'the key must never go through set /p');
});

test('uninstall removes the task and hooks but keeps the data unless explicitly told', () => {
  const bat = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'uninstall_memo.bat'), 'latin1');
  assert.match(bat, /-Remove/);
  assert.match(bat, /setup claude --remove/);
  assert.match(bat, /DELETE-ALL-MEMO-DATA/);
  assert.match(bat, /NOT deleted/);
});

test('register-task.ps1 takes the documented parameters and never duplicates the task', () => {
  const ps = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DIR, 'register-task.ps1'), 'latin1');
  for (const needle of ['$NodeExe', '$MemoJs', '$TaskName', '$IntervalMinutes', '$Remove',
    'MultipleInstances IgnoreNew', 'StartWhenAvailable', 'ExecutionTimeLimit', 'AtLogOn', 'Set-ScheduledTask']) {
    assert.ok(ps.includes(needle), 'register-task.ps1 should mention ' + needle);
  }
});
```
